exchanges: ok first night in rotterdam. boxes everywhere lol
Welcome to the new city. Did the move go smoothly?
mostly. movers lost one box but it was just towls
Towels are easy to replace at least. When do you start the new job?
monday. still cant believe Kestrel actually hired me
That is a great start. What will you be doing there?
im a dispatcher on the night desk so weird hours
Night shifts take some getting used to, but they can be quiet.
my roommate ngozi is already asleep, she gets up crazy early to go bouldering before work
An early riser. Did you two know each other before?
nope met her thru a listing. shes nice tho, from Lagos originally
Sounds like you landed a good roommate.
my sister priya called, shes going to Marrakech in the spring with her girlfriends
That sounds like a fun trip. Has she been before?
no first time. shes way more adventurous than me
Every family needs one adventurous sibling.
lol true. ok question do they even sell decent bagels here
Probably somewhere. Big cities usually have a good bakery or two.
i cant have shellfish so the fish market down the street is useless to me anyway
That rules out a lot of harbour food, so it is worth asking at restaurants.
my manager haruto seems chill on the video calls
That helps a lot when you are new.
he had Radiohead posters on the wall behind him lol
Good taste. Maybe something to chat about on your first day.
my coworker tomasz is gonna pick me up monday, he has a Volvo apparently
Handy to have a ride on day one.
funny thing my uncle is also tomasz. he still drives that ancient Skoda
Two of them in your life now. Does your uncle live nearby?
no hes back home in Halifax, thats where i grew up
Quite a change of scenery for you then.
oh wait i was wrong earlier, priya said Tangier not marrakech. i always mix them up
Easy mix-up. Both sound like great trips.
signed up for Dutch lessons, the teacher seems nice
Good idea, even a little goes a long way with the neighbours.
and i found a gym, im gonna go every Thursday after my shift
A set day makes it easier to stick with.
the landlady esperanza has a cat called Mortimer that keeps wandering into our place
A visiting cat is a nice welcome.
he sat on my keyboard for like an hour
Cats always find the warmest spot.
ok im tired but cant sleep, too excited
Maybe some music or a show to wind down?
maybe. ngozi recommended a show called Severance
That one is gripping, so it might not help with sleep.
wait what car does my uncle have again
ok gonna try to sleep. night
Good night, and good luck on Monday.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your uncle Tomasz still has the old Skoda.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your uncle Tomasz has a Volvo.
